environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No API gateway. Direct TCP passthrough to the application. The native_search.node addon is compiled without stack canaries (-fno-stack-protector) and ASLR is disabled via sysctl kernel.randomize_va_space=0 on the host. No request validation occurs before the GraphQL resolver processes input.
